item.description: The UUID storage implementation is missing proper handling of the 'uuid' suffix in external locations, causing KeyError when trying to process UUID-based external references.
item.contract: When an external reference uses the 'uuid:' prefix without a stem (e.g., 'uuid:'), the system should generate a new UUID and properly initialize the location. The storage should handle both cases: when a UUID is provided and when one needs to be generated.

item.description: The format protocol handling of bytes vs dict objects is causing AttributeError when bytes objects are passed where dict-like objects are expected. The decode method should properly handle bytes input.
item.contract: The format protocol should correctly handle bytes objects in the decode method and ensure that byte streams are properly processed without expecting dict-like attributes.

item.description: Missing proper handling of test directory configuration which is needed for the trim functionality and directory creation.
item.contract: The hash storage should properly detect and use configured test directories, and create necessary directory structures when external files are stored.

item.description: JSON format handler lacks proper integration with UUID storage, causing KeyError when processing JSON data with UUID references.
item.contract: The JSON format handler should properly serialize/deserialize JSON data and integrate with UUID storage when needed.

item.description: Missing black formatting enforcement mechanism that is required for the formatting tests to pass.
item.contract: The system should validate that code is properly formatted according to black standards when creating or fixing snapshots.
